title: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane that, in this present, is ruled by dragons and five dragon clans rather than the five khans.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled back in time more than a thousand years and saved Ugin, thereby creating a world where dragons rule.

entities.name: Ugin, the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: A planeswalker and powerful spirit dragon from whom all dragons were formed; his magic feeds the dragon tempests.

entities.name: The dragon tempests
entities.description: Storms that feed on Ugin's magic and are the source of all dragons on Tarkir.

entities.name: The Khanfall
entities.description: The fall of the ancient humanoid khans and their clans to the dragons more than a thousand years ago.

entities.name: The khans
entities.description: The ancient humanoid rulers of Tarkir's clans in the original timeline, destroyed by the dragons.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: An elder dragon and dragonlord for whom a dragon clan is named, embodying Endurance.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: An ancient, insightful dragonlord of the Ojutai clan who roosts at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary and Cori Mountain.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A cruel, murderous, paranoid dragonlord of the Silumgar clan with a growing undead army, who has sat atop his mountain of gold for over a thousand years.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: An elder dragon and dragonlord, Silumgar's rival, embodying Speed.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: An elder dragon and dragonlord for whom a dragon clan is named, embodying Savagery.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: The Mardu khan in Sarkhan's original timeline, who in this present must bow to a dragonlord.

entities.name: Ojutai clan
entities.description: A monastic dragon clan of monks and mystics that embodies cunning, symbolized by the dragon's eye.

entities.name: Silumgar clan
entities.description: The dragon clan of ruthlessness, symbolized by the fang of the dragon, with a top-down hierarchy and large undead numbers.

entities.name: Kolaghan clan
entities.description: A dragon clan whose raiding party disguised as merchants attacked Dirgur.

entities.name: The Sultai
entities.description: An extinct clan that once used the cast-off bodies of other clans to make a working class and an army of the dead.

entities.name: The Jeskai
entities.description: A clan whose temples are raided by the Silumgar clan; proud of being among the best educated.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A gifted Ojutai student who became a master, grew restless, and secretly researched Tarkir's forbidden past.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A male human head scholar and spellfist instructor at Cori Mountain Sanctuary, fluent in Draconic, who warned Narset.

entities.name: Ishai
entities.description: A female aven who is Ojutai's current dragonspeaker, with great autonomy and authority.

entities.name: Zhiada
entities.description: A female human head warrior of Dirgur Sanctuary who killed a Kolaghan raiding party's orc leader and wears his teeth.

entities.name: Siara, the Dragon's Mouth
entities.description: A female human, chief among Silumgar's dragonspeakers, who proclaims his edicts.

entities.name: Xathi the Infallible
entities.description: A human dragonslayer reserved by Silumgar to kill his most dangerous rivals.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: An undead naga vizier, formerly Silumgar's translator, executed and raised as an intelligent undead servant; rallies naga and sibsig.

entities.name: Dragon's Eye Sanctuary
entities.description: The greatest Ojutai sanctuary and secondary roost of Ojutai, on a mountainside at the edge of a bay.

entities.name: Cori Mountain Sanctuary
entities.description: Ojutai's primary roost and intellectual retreat, built inside an ancient flooded caldera.

entities.name: Dirgur
entities.description: An Ojutai sanctuary on a lake island closest to other clans' territories, frequently attacked.

entities.name: Icefall
entities.description: An Ojutai sanctuary built into a cliff face with a frozen waterwheel.

entities.name: Marang River Fortress
entities.description: The seat of Silumgar's power, where the jungle meets the mountains.

entities.name: Qarsi Palace
entities.description: A luxurious jungle palace where Silumgar scholars and sorcerers train in dark magic.

entities.name: Ukud Necropolis
entities.description: A temple built in the time of the khans to house Sultai nobility, now the resting place of Silumgar's high-ranking dragons and a treasure vault.

entities.name: Gudul
entities.description: Islands in the river delta guarded by monsters and undead.

entities.name: Gurmag Swamp
entities.description: A treacherous swampland belt riddled with sibsig around Silumgar's domain.

entities.name: Sibsig
entities.description: Zombies used as warriors by Silumgar, imbued with twisted dark energy.

entities.name: Naga
entities.description: Serpentine translators in Silumgar's clan, who claim kinship with dragons but hold minimal power.

entities.name: Rakshasas
entities.description: Demons in Silumgar's clan in an uneasy truce with the dragons.

entities.name: The Great Wheel
entities.description: The Ojutai belief in a cycle of reincarnation whose goal is rebirth as a dragon.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol travels back in time over a thousand years and saves Ugin from death, securing the dragon tempests.
events.quote: he traveled back in time more than a thousand years to a crucial turning point, and there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death

events.summary: With dragons secured, their numbers grow and the dragons hunt down and destroy the khans.
events.quote: Ultimately, the dragons were able to hunt down the khans and destroy them.

events.summary: The Khanfall: each khan falls and their clans with them; five dragon clans rise under the dragonlords.
events.quote: one by one, each of the ancient humanoid khans fell, and their clans fell with them

events.summary: The dragons turn on each other and allow humanoids to support them, forming five dragon-led clans.
events.quote: After the khans were defeated, the dragons turned their attentions to each other.

events.summary: Even Zurgo, the Mardu khan of the original timeline, must bow to a dragonlord.
events.quote: Even Zurgo—the Mardu khan in Sarkhan's original timeline—must bow to a dragonlord.

events.summary: Narset gains Ojutai's personal notice as a child and is taken on as a student.
events.quote: Ojutai recognized hers as a mind with the potential for nearly limitless growth, so she was taken on as a student.

events.summary: Narset grows restless and begins to doubt that Ojutai knows all the answers.
events.quote: she started to question whether or not Ojutai truly knew all the answers to the questions of life

events.summary: Narset becomes a master and secretly explores the Ojutai sanctuaries for the forbidden past, ignoring Taigam's warning.
events.quote: Her peer, Taigam, warned her of the danger in seeking out knowledge without the dragonlord's permission, but Narset saw no harm in research.

events.summary: Narset discovers that Tarkir was once ruled by khans and learns of the spirit dragon from whom all dragons were formed.
events.quote: Narset also learned of a powerful spirit dragon from whom all dragons were formed.

events.summary: Taigam, once tempted to leave Cori Mountain, reaffirms himself to the Ojutai cause.
events.quote: Taigam eventually saw that only Ojutai could deliver true wisdom and reaffirmed himself to the Ojutai cause.

events.summary: A Kolaghan raiding party disguised as merchants catches Dirgur's garrison off guard; Zhiada kills its orc leader.
events.quote: She personally killed the raiding party's leader, a huge orc, although the survivors fled with clan treasures.

events.summary: Silumgar's dragonlord discovers Sidisi's manipulation of translations and has her executed.
events.quote: when he discovered her manipulation, the paranoid dragonlord had her executed

events.summary: Silumgar has Sidisi raised as an intelligent undead servant.
events.quote: so he had her raised as an intelligent undead servant, one he could more closely control

events.summary: Sidisi rallies the naga and gains the allegiance of many sibsig, though she remains loyal to Silumgar for now.
events.quote: Sidisi has been able to rally the naga and gain the allegiance of a large number of sibsig zombies

relations.quote: there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death

relations.note: The dragonlord dominates the clan that bears his name
relations.quote: The truth of how he came to dominate the clan that bears his name has been lost in the mists of history.

relations.note: Narset was taken on as Ojutai's student
relations.quote: so she was taken on as a student
This female aven is Ojutai's current dragonspeaker.

relations.note: Taigam preserves and copies the Great Teacher's wisdom
relations.quote: Tasked with preserving and copying the collected wisdom of the Great Teacher

relations.note: Zhiada killed the Kolaghan raiding party's leader
relations.quote: the garrison at Dirgur was caught off guard by a raiding party of Kolaghan disguised as a merchant crew

relations.note: Silumgar obsesses over losing everything to his rival
relations.quote: he obsesses over losing everything to his rival, Kolaghan

relations.note: A top-down hierarchy with Silumgar at the top
relations.quote: The clan of ruthlessness is a top-down hierarchy with Silumgar at the top and his dragon-kind immediately below him.
for now, she remains loyal to Silumgar

relations.note: Silumgar had her executed before raising her as undead
relations.quote: the paranoid dragonlord had her executed
Silumgar reserves a special human dragonslayer to kill off his most dangerous rivals.
She proclaims the edicts and mandates of Silumgar and warns others of her master's mood.
